title: One idea. An entire creative world.

sourceConcepts.equivalents: Four user supplied concepts rebuilt as native editable geometry, UV media surfaces, animated typography, independently moving UI, AP sculpture and physical studio. Two photographic equivalents derived with imagegen; full reference plates are never slideshow inputs.

scenes.line: Every great story starts as an idea.
scenes.transition: The active timeline grows out of the first idea stroke; library cards rise from that same plane.
The component grid folds into dimensional rails as its central line unfolds into a ribbon.
The ribbon opens into a horizon; the rails become the contours of the story world.

scenes.line: And experience becomes a story people remember.
scenes.transition: The horizon contracts into the final single luminous stroke while dimensional AP contours assemble.
Anticipation, rim-light travel, monogram assembly, brand hit and clean final hold.

voiceover: Not generated: the optional narration is retained verbatim as separately editable title layers with clean insertion windows.
sound: Original deterministic stereo score and separate ambient/UI/transition/brand cues; one motif develops harmonically, increases rhythm at the unfolding and resolves at 34.6 seconds.
